title: Service Area Map: Draw Your Coverage
description: Plan delivery and service coverage on a Service Area Map — distance rings and reach around your base, before live-traffic refinement. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, a 10-mile service ring around a depot covers 314 square miles — the map makes that either a confident promise or an obvious overreach, in one look.
quick_answer: A Service Area Map plans delivery or service coverage using distance and reach around a base — draw the ring, read the ground it covers, and judge the promise before customers test it. This page works in straight-line reach, the honest first draft that drive-time tools later refine.
